newsitem.title: UK: Storehouse says to accelerate Bhs refitting.
newsitem.headline: Storehouse says to accelerate Bhs refitting.

text.p: British retail group Storehouse Plc said on Friday its Bhs business would accelerate its "millennium" store refitting programme after Bhs' "millennium" trial stores traded ahead of other Bhs stores over Christmas.

In a statement Storehouse said nearly every Bhs store would incorporate elements of the "millennium" programme by March next year. The programme is expected to cost around 25 million stg and refit over 50 shops, Storehouse said.

"It is now clear that Bhs "millennium" store design can improve like-for-like sales and store profitability even at preak trading times....The sooner we can refit the whole chain the better," group chief executive Keith Edelmann said.
